currentPage.seoDescription: A collection of tools that will help you become a more fully devoted follower of Christ.
currentPage.title: Tools for Growth | Life.Church
currentPage.seoKeywords: tools, resources, Bible, app, podcasts, grow

00.headingText: Use these apps and resources to help you seek God during the week.

0.title: Life.Church App
0.content: Connect with your location, take a next step, watch messages, listen to music or podcasts, give securely, check in, and more.

00.content: Have the Bible with you no matter where you go with this website and free app for your phone or tablet.
00.title: Bible App

01.content: Get practical, relevant, and biblical perspectives on topics that matter to you. Listen to the latest episode now.
01.title: Life.Church Podcast

0.title: Craig Groeschel Leadership Podcast
0.content: Get timely insights from Pastor Craig and his guests to make the most of your leadership potential.

01.content: Finds helps simplifiy faith with personal, practical articles featuring example prayers, spiritual growth tips, and Bible explainers.
01.title: Faith Building Articles

00.content: Want to learn how to study the Bible? The five steps in this guide will help you read and understand the Bible more so you can grow closer to God.
00.title: Your Bible Guide

0.content: Become part of a community. Find or start a LifeGroup where you can be real and belong.
0.title: LifeGroups

00.title: Known
00.content: Get to know others, yourself, and our church in a relational way, and learn how we can follow Jesus together.

01.alt: Man holding an umbrella for woman walking into church
01.title: Serve at Life.Church
01.content: Serve at Life.Church. It’s one of the best ways to meet people, develop relationships, and grow as a follower of Christ.

0.headingText: Make an Impact in Your Community

0.subTitle: Conversations About the Kingdom
0.content: Discover what it means to follow Jesus and learn to live like Him.
0.title: Following Jesus

00.alt: You've Heard It Said Podcast Image
00.title: You’ve Heard It Said Podcast
00.content: Hear honest discussions about the things that matter to you, and get a deeper understanding of who God made you to be.

01.content: Live out your faith. Jesus called it loving your neighbor as yourself, and we’re all about it.
01.title: Love Your Neighbor

0.content: Every family needs a place to belong. We’ll connect you to relationships and resources to help you parent with confidence!
0.title: LC Parents

00.content: Experience LifeKids anytime! Get the same lessons, videos, and music your kids experience each week.
00.title: LifeKids Media

01.title: Bible App for Kids
01.content: Help your kids fall in love with God’s Word through colorful illustrations, animated storybooks, games, and more!
